fact: At a Somali Media Association event on 28 September 2025, the Ministry of Information's Director of Strategic Management said consultations were held on the Access to Information Law, the Cabinet has passed it, and it awaits presentation to the Lower House for ratification; participants noted that no such law yet exists.

The joint submission to the UN Universal Periodic Review says the Council of Ministers approved the Official Information Bill in March 2024 and submitted it to the House of the People of the Federal Parliament for consideration; it criticises its broad exemptions and secret drafting.
